beats.text: Jesus told one more short story, only two lines long.

beats.speaker: jesus
beats.text: Again, the kingdom of heaven is like unto a merchant man, seeking goodly pearls:

timing.text: Again, the kingdom of heaven is like unto a merchant man, seeking goodly pearls:

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: He spent his whole life traveling and searching, handling the finest pearls in the world, always hunting for something better.

timing.text: He spent his whole life traveling and searching, handling the finest pearls in the world, always hunting for something better.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: He had seen a lot of beautiful pearls. Good ones. Costly ones. But he kept looking, because not one of them was the one.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: And then one day, he found it. A single pearl, more perfect and more precious than anything he had ever held. The pearl he had been looking for his whole life.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: And he knew, the moment he saw it, exactly what he was going to do.

beats.speaker: jesus
beats.text: Who, when he had found one pearl of great price, went and sold all that he had, and bought it.

timing.text: Who, when he had found one pearl of great price, went and sold all that he had, and bought it.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: He went home and sold everything. His house, his goods, every other pearl he owned. All of it, gone, to buy the one.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: And here is the thing. He did not do it grieving. He did not feel robbed. He gave up everything he had, gladly, because what he was getting was worth more than all of it put together.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: That is what finding the real thing does. When you finally find what your whole life was looking for, letting go of the rest is not a loss. It is the easiest trade you will ever make.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: And there is one more wonder hidden in this little story. Some have read it the other way around, and it is just as true. That to Jesus, you are the pearl.

beats.text: That he is the merchant who went looking, who found you, and who gave up everything he had, his own life, gladly, to buy you back. That is how good he is. You were worth all of it to him.
